bio: 'Anna Meier (Mrs. Frederick)', who died in Wilkes-Barre on 9 Feb 1940 aged 47, was Anna Mather, wife of Fred Aloysius Meier Sr. (Henry J. Meier's eldest son). The FamilySearch tree gives her as born 28 Aug 1892 in Pennsylvania, daughter of John Mather (1854–1914) and Hanna M. Flynn (1855–1924). She lived in Wilkes-Barre in 1900 and 1910 (Ward 16), married Fred on 21 Apr 1915, and died 9 Feb 1940. She is buried at St. Mary's Cemetery, Hanover Township (Find a Grave index) ([R4-S1]). Her children were Florence Irene (1916–1933), Fred A. Jr. (1918–2000), Gerald Francis (1921–1994) and Henry James 'Harry' (1923–1943). Her death is a separate event from Henry J. Meier's death, which was in December 1950, not 1940.
